Return assay chembl_id, target type, tax_id, canonical SMILES, molecule chembl_id, standard type, and pChEMBL value. Use only exact standard relation '=', non-null pChEMBL values, and order by molecule chembl_id and assay chembl_id. No additional filtering on assays or documents; results must be sorted but not limited by number of rows, and no extra rows should be excluded beyond the specified conditions.
sql:
SELECT DISTINCT ass.chembl_id AS assay_chembl_id,
       td.target_type,
       td.tax_id,
       cs.canonical_smiles,
       md.chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id,
       a.standard_type,
       a.pchembl_value
FROM activities a
JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id
JOIN target_dictionary td ON ass.tid = td.tid
JOIN compound_structures cs ON a.molecule_chembl_id = cs.molecule_chembl_id
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molecule_chembl_id = md.molecule_chembl_id
WHERE a.standard_type = 'IC50'
  AND a.standard_value IS NOT NULL
  AND a.standard_units IS NOT NULL
  AND a.pchembl_value IS NOT NULL
  AND a.standard_relation = '='
  AND td.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL2163185'
ORDER BY md.chembl_id,
         ass.chembl_id;

    SELECT a.activity_id,
           a.standard_type,

           a.molregno,
           a.assay_id

    WHERE a.standard_type = 'IC50'
      AND a.pchembl_value IS NOT NULL
      AND a.standard_relation = '='
      AND a.molregno IS NOT NULL
),
assay_targets AS (
    SELECT ass.assay_id,
           ass.chembl_id,
           td.chembl_id AS target_chembl_id,
           td.target_type,
           td.tax_id

    JOIN target_dictionary td ON ass.tid = td.tid

       at.tax_id,

       md.chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id,
       fa.standard_type,
       fa.pchembl_value

JOIN assay_targets at ON fa.assay_id = at.assay_id
JOIN compound_structures cs ON fa.molregno = cs.molregno
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON fa.molregno = md.molregno
ORDER BY md.chembl_id,
         at.assay_chembl_id
LIMIT 1000;
